args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Essentials
- Passport
- Plane ticket
- Travel insurance
- Driver's license
- Credit cards
- Debit cards
- Cash

### Clothing
- 3-4 tops
- 2-3 bottoms (lightweight pants/shorts)
- 1-2 swimsuits
- 1-2 light jackets (evenings can be cool)
- Undergarments
- Socks
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip flops
- Dressier outfit for dinner at luaus

### Toiletries
- Toothbrush
- Toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Shampoo
- Conditioner
- Body wash
- Razor
- Shaving cream
- Makeup
- Hairbrush
- Contact lenses/glasses
- Prescription medication

### Electronics
- Smartphone
- Laptop
- Camera
- Portable charger
- Power adapter
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach speakers
- Waterproof Bluetooth speaker

### Beach and Water
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Beach towels
- Beach blanket
- Snorkeling gear
- Snorkeling mask
- Snorkeling fins
- Beach bag
- Water shoes
- Surfboard rental info

### Food and Snacks
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks (granola bars, trail mix)
- Beach snacks (chips, fruit)
- Cooler with ice packs
- Sandwiches/wraps
- Fresh fruit
- Energy bars
- Trail mix

### Miscellaneous
- Travel-size umbrella
- Sunglasses
- Sunglasses case
- Beach umbrella
- Beach chairs
- Beach toys
- Water bottle refillable
- Reusable straw
- Travel pillow
- Earplugs
- Eye mask
- First aid kit
- Sunscreen stick
- After-sun lotion
- Insect repellent
- Power strip
- Packing cubes
- Packing list copy

### Hawaii Specific
- Collapsible cooler
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Hawaiian shirts
- Aloha spirit!
